title: feat: alert when the legacy text or image API stops working
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The el405b monitoring bot now checks the legacy text and image APIs every 30 minutes, comparing each API’s traffic and success rate for the last full hour with the same hour over the previous seven days. If either measure falls below half its normal level, the bot posts a DEGRADED alert in #dev-agentstream tagging Elliot, at most once every three hours per API, followed by a recovery message when the measure returns to normal. It saves the baseline when an alert begins so a prolonged outage cannot become the new normal. Healthy-hour figures stay in the bot log; community-model alerts are unchanged. The read-only Tinybird query was checked with production data for both API keys, the alert rule was tested against edge cases, and 18 bot tests pass.
